# The column inventory of the long-lived GreenPut databases (`greenput` and
# `greenput-staging`) as observed on 2026-09-11. Both databases had identical
# column sets at that moment, so this file is the conservative floor: every
# column listed here is guaranteed to already exist on a database that predates
# Its ONLY purpose is to anchor scripts/db/check-migration-coverage.mjs, which
# asserts that every column schema.sql declares is either in this snapshot or
# added by an `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` in migrations/. Regenerating it from
# a newer database would make that check vacuous — the drift it exists to catch
# would be absorbed into the baseline. If a column is missing from a live
# database, the fix is a new migration, never an edit here.
